## Default

Set the username once in your YAML and drop the shortcode wherever you want it:

```` markdown
---
duolingo:
  user: joohbonny
---

{{{< duolingo >}}}
````

{{< duolingo >}}

The data is fetched **while the document renders**, so the published page is
plain HTML — no JavaScript, no API calls from the visitor's browser.

## Languages

`lang` controls both the labels and the number formatting.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
{{< duolingo lang="pt" >}}

{{< duolingo lang="es" >}}

{{< duolingo lang="fr" >}}

{{< duolingo lang="de" >}}
:::

## Themes

`auto` (the default) follows the reader's system setting and the Quarto dark
toggle. `light` and `dark` pin it.

::: {layout-ncol=2}
{{< duolingo theme="light" >}}

{{< duolingo theme="dark" >}}
:::

## Accent colour

{{< duolingo accent="#ff4b4b" >}}

{{< duolingo accent="#1cb0f6" >}}

## Compact layout

Fits a sidebar or a footer:

{{< duolingo layout="compact" lang="pt" >}}

## Picking the stats

{{< duolingo stats="streak,xp" courses="0" avatar="false" >}}

## Another user

Any public profile works:

{{< duolingo user="Luis" lang="en" >}}
